notes:
**New: a separate OpenVPN section (Windows)**

- Own server list, tester and connect button, separate from V2Ray/Xray. Full view: "OpenVPN" in the sidebar. Compact view: the switch at the top. Only one connection runs at a time; switching stops the other one.
- Free servers from VPN Gate (with a GitHub/jsDelivr mirror when vpngate.net is blocked) and VPNBook (its rotating password is fetched for you). You can also import your own .ovpn files.
- Light on data: each server gets one tiny handshake (about 120 bytes). No automatic speed tests. Server lists are only downloaded again after 30 minutes.
- Comes with the official OpenVPN 2.6.23. The first connect installs the signed TAP network driver (needs admin). You can turn on the faster ovpn-dco driver in Settings for servers that support it.
- Shows your exit IP after connecting. "Check clean" runs the cleanliness check when you ask. The Tunnel DNS setting applies to OpenVPN too.
- Sources can be switched on or off in Settings, and each one shows how many of its servers worked.

Android: no changes (it doesn't have the OpenVPN section).
